brief: The cached ground/facade layer (`drawGround`, repainted when `lightBucket` changes at `courtyard.html` ~5584: `lb = floor(hour*4)*8 + round(cloudCover()*6)`) steps a quarter sim-hour at a time. Near sunUp/sunDown that is where the light changes fastest, so on a winter afternoon the WHOLE picture relights in one frame — `filmstrip.mjs` reads 5–9 whole-frame mean-Δ at winter dusk on HEAD (#45 measured it; no feature in this town produces more than ~2). Make the dusk and dawn relight continuous to the eye: either a finer bucket only within ~1.5 h of the sun's edges (rebuild cost is the constraint — measure it with `perf.mjs`), or a live screen-space tint over the cached layer between buckets so each bucket step lands on a picture already most of the way there. The noon bucket cadence must not change.
successLooksLike: `filmstrip.mjs` at winter dusk (seed 7, t≈1183) and summer dusk: max single-frame Δ under 3 on both, HEAD's 5–9 reproduced first as the control. perf.mjs within noise of HEAD across a whole day (no more than +10% rebuilds per sim day).
